purpose: User-requested uniform MPC versus a fixed, deliberately untuned HCO
initial_state_policy: Preserve manuscript mechanical and six neuronal initial states; no recalibration or reset
startup_policy: Both use the specified theta during the first half-swing; MPC optimizes only once the first complete detector pair is available
bounds_note: User-authorized gain bounds [1.5,2.5] x [1,2], containing the initial gains. This overrides the paper's narrower bounds only for this new comparison.

performance_plot.amplitude: Absolute signed half-swing extremum, in degrees; reference magnitude 5 degrees
performance_plot.crossing: Crossing-time error relative to event_index*0.05 seconds, displayed in milliseconds
performance_plot.energy: Absolute mechanical energy exchange integral per half-swing, in microjoules
